name: Judging False Prophets
overview: Scripture warns believers to exercise discernment regarding false prophets, who may appear harmless but are inwardly dangerous, as Jesus cautions in Matthew 7:15. The validity of a prophet’s message is confirmed by the fulfillment of their words, as Deuteronomy 18:22 instructs, emphasizing that unfulfilled prophecy reveals a false prophet. Furthermore, Matthew 24:24 highlights the severity of deception false prophets can bring, performing signs and wonders capable of misleading even the elect, underscoring the necessity of Christ-centered vigilance in judgment.
